SELECT firstName, lastName FROM Master WHERE birthYear = 1990 AND birthCountry != 'USA'
SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lgID IN ('PCHA', 'NHL') GROUP BY T1.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.lgID) = 2

SELECT T1.nameGiven, T2.year, AVG(CAST(T2.Min AS REAL)) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = (SELECT playerID FROM Goalies GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT year) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T1.nameGiven, T2.year
SELECT nameGiven, firstNHL, firstWHA FROM Master WHERE firstNHL IS NOT NULL AND firstWHA IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID AND T2.year = T3.year WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T1.birthCountry = 'Canada'

SELECT T2.nameGiven, T3.name, T3.year FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T2.coachID = T1.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T2.coachID IS NOT NULL
